skills.name: accessibility-review
skills.desc: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a design or page. Trigger with "audit accessibility", "check a11y", "is this accessible?", or when reviewing a design for color contrast, keyboard navigation, touch target size, or screen reader behavior before handoff.

skills.name: architecture
skills.desc: Create or evaluate an architecture decision record (ADR). Use when choosing between technologies (e.g., Kafka vs SQS), documenting a design decision with trade-offs and consequences, reviewing a system design proposal, or designing a new component from requirements and constraints.

skills.name: code-review
skills.desc: Review code changes for security, performance, and correctness. Trigger with a PR URL or diff, "review this before I merge", "is this code safe?", or when checking a change for N+1 queries, injection risks, missing edge cases, or error handling gaps.

skills.name: competitive-brief
skills.desc: Create a competitive analysis brief for one or more competitors or a feature area. Use when informing product strategy or feature prioritization, building sales battle cards, prepping board or investor materials, or deciding where to differentiate vs. achieve parity.

skills.name: debug
skills.desc: Structured debugging session — reproduce, isolate, diagnose, and fix. Trigger with an error message or stack trace, "this works in staging but not prod", "something broke after the deploy", or when behavior diverges from expected and the cause isn't obvious.

skills.name: design-critique
skills.desc: Get structured design feedback on usability, hierarchy, and consistency. Trigger with "review this design", "critique this mockup", "what do you think of this screen?", or when sharing a Figma link or screenshot for feedback at any stage from exploration to final polish.

skills.name: design-handoff
skills.desc: Generate developer handoff specs from a design. Use when a design is ready for engineering and needs a spec sheet covering layout, design tokens, component props, interaction states, responsive breakpoints, edge cases, and animation details.

skills.name: design-system
skills.desc: Audit, document, or extend your design system. Use when checking for naming inconsistencies or hardcoded values across components, writing documentation for a component's variants, states, and accessibility notes, or designing a new pattern that fits the existing system.

skills.name: documentation
skills.desc: Write and maintain technical documentation. Trigger with "write docs for", "document this", "create a README", "write a runbook", "onboarding guide", or when the user needs help with any form of technical writing — API docs, architecture docs, or operational runbooks.

skills.name: google-tasks
skills.desc: Add, list, update, complete, or delete items in Google Tasks (tasks.google.com) via the official Tasks API. Use when the user wants to put a TODO into Google Tasks, mark one done, or check what's on the list. Default task list is "マイタスク" (@default).

skills.name: pdf-import
skills.desc: PDF（およびスライド資料・画像）を Google ドライブの「他社資料・セミナー」フォルダ内に整理して保存するスキル。原本ファイルをそのままの形式で、YYMMDD_ 命名規則で作成したサブフォルダにまとめ、要約テキストを添える。ユーザーが PDF や画像を添付して「ドライブに入れて」「保存して」「要約してドキュメント化」と依頼した時に使う。

skills.name: product-brainstorming
skills.desc: Brainstorm product ideas, explore problem spaces, and challenge assumptions as a thinking partner. Use when exploring a new opportunity, generating solutions to a product problem, stress-testing an idea, or when a PM needs to think out loud with a sharp sparring partner before converging on a direction.

skills.name: research-synthesis
skills.desc: Synthesize user research into themes, insights, and recommendations. Use when you have interview transcripts, survey results, usability test notes, support tickets, or NPS responses that need to be distilled into patterns, user segments, and prioritized next steps.

skills.name: roadmap-update
skills.desc: Update, create, or reprioritize your product roadmap. Use when adding a new initiative and deciding what moves to make room, shifting priorities after new information comes in, moving timelines due to a dependency slip, or building a Now/Next/Later view from scratch.

skills.name: testing-strategy
skills.desc: Design test strategies and test plans. Trigger with "how should we test", "test strategy for", "write tests for", "test plan", "what tests do we need", or when the user needs help with testing approaches, coverage, or test architecture.

skills.name: undraw-fetch
skills.desc: スライド・HTML・画像を作成する際に、イラストの指定がない場合、unDraw APIからSVGイラストを自動取得して埋め込む。ライセンスはMIT・商用OK・帰属表示不要。`/undraw-fetch` と呼び出すか、スライド/カード/画像生成時にイラスト指定がなければ自動適用する。

skills.name: user-research
skills.desc: Plan, conduct, and synthesize user research. Trigger with "user research plan", "interview guide", "usability test", "survey design", "research questions", or when the user needs help with any aspect of understanding their users through research.

skills.name: ux-copy
skills.desc: Write or review UX copy — microcopy, error messages, empty states, CTAs. Trigger with "write copy for", "what should this button say?", "review this error message", or when naming a CTA, wording a confirmation dialog, filling an empty state, or writing onboarding text.

skills.name: write-spec
skills.desc: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea. Use when turning a vague idea or user request into a structured document, scoping a feature with goals and non-goals, defining success metrics and acceptance criteria, or breaking a big ask into a phased spec.

skills.name: youtube-import
skills.desc: YouTube動画URLを検出すると自動起動し、文字起こし＋要約＋Wordドキュメント保存を完結するスキル。ユーザーが `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=` を含むメッセージを送ったら即座にこのスキルを呼び出す。「文字起こし」「要約」「議事録化」「ドライブに入れて」等の依頼も対象。
